verdict.rationale: Bulk public-data extracts are a fair question for a state Secretary of State, which keeps business-entity registries, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of any published dataset, registry extract or bulk download. The only probes show the front door (www.nvsos.gov) and the ORION filing portal blocked to keyless agents by Akamai and Incapsula bot walls, which says nothing about whether a bulk-data offering exists.
